attributes.action: Expand World Cup Licensing Extensions to Include Englands Game on Sunday Night
attributes.additional_details: The Government extended licensing hours for selected World Cup matches but excluded England v Mexico at 1:00am on Monday 6 July. Most pubs cannot legally stay open, despite claims that pubs were being supported. Temporary Event Notices are not a realistic solution, as venues have a limited number each year and England’s qualification was confirmed after the standard application deadline. Amend the extension so fans can watch England safely in their local pub.
attributes.background: The Government extended licensing for some World Cup matches but excluded England v Mexico at 1am on 6 July. Pubs had no realistic chance to obtain a TEN, as qualification was confirmed after the deadline. Amend the extension so fans can watch England in their local pub.

rejection.details: When our team got to your petition in the petitions queue, the date of the England vs Mexico World Cup game had already passed.
